title: Transport of one adjacent compact-support coefficient square
statement: Fix a prime l, finite E/Q_l, compactification c=(j,p) of f:X→Y and normalized operations o,d,e [lem-sf-compact-support-proper-image-tower]. Supply any family ι of ordinary finite open extension isomorphisms satisfying the ordinary coefficient equation SfFiniteOpenPresentationCompatible [lem-sf-finite-open-presentation-coefficients]. For arbitrary completed-coefficient K, construct β_n=Res_n D_n((mapDerivedCategoryNatIso ι_n).app (L_n K)); this is sfSupportPresentationLevel. Then supportTransition_n followed by β_n equals β_(n+1) followed by sfCompactSupportTransition_n [def-sf-integral-compact-support-tower]. The conclusion is equality of these specified morphisms for one adjacent index, not existence of a system comparison. No completeness or constructibility is imposed.

proof.text: Transport additivity and exactness along each supplied ordinary finite open isomorphism. Keep sfSupportPresentationLevel as the actual mapIso construction: exact localization of the supplied isomorphism, right-derived finite direct image, and completed restriction. No data are selected from an existence theorem.

Use uniqueness of the identity-on-sections ordinary restriction comparison to identify sfCompactSupportRestrictionComp with the eqToIso of coefficientRestrictionComp, after the supplied adjacent-restriction equality. Naturality of mapDerivedCategoryCompIso in its first functor gives restrictionComp, the equality of the two derived restriction associators including the derived adjacent-restriction presentation. Apply the higher scalar adjunction Hom equivalence to the two quotient arrows. Naturality in its target and cancellation of the presentation isomorphism identify reductionMap followed by that presentation with sfCompactSupportReductionTransition (reductionMap_change).

Localize hι using multiplicativity of mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and naturality of mapDerivedCategoryCompIso in both functors. Cancellation of the composition isomorphisms proves derivedSquare_change. Evaluate it at the lower finite reduction of K. Naturality of the adjacent-restriction presentation and of the localized upper open isomorphism, followed by reductionMap_change, gives openSquare_transport: the commuting adjacent open square before applying any direct image.

Prove uniqueness of a derived comparison satisfying CompactSupportDerivedSquareNormalization. Represent an arbitrary derived object by a K-injective J and resolve its restricted complex by I. The normalization fixes the comparison after a common tail. That tail is invertible: its composite with either comparison equals a composite of localization factors, the image of the quasi-isomorphism to I, and the K-injective computation isomorphism. Cancel the tail, then use naturality along the representing isomorphism. Prove the ordinary direct-image comparison over arbitrary finite coefficient rings: substitute the two ordinary restriction-functor equalities, making their eqToIso presentations reflexive; cancel the canonical comparison and use the two section normalizations. Specialize this functor equality to the actual quotient rings and d.sections. Transport the derived comparisons along the same ordinary functor equalities, and apply the just-proved uniqueness to d.normalization and the canonical proEtaleDerivedDirectImage_restrictScalars normalization. This proves directComparison without asserting that scalar restriction preserves K-injectivity.

Apply restrictedComparison to the adjacent open square, directComparison and restrictionComp. First change the presentation of the coefficient restriction by functoriality, then use naturality of the intrinsic derived direct-image square at the lower open comparison and naturality of the completed restriction composition map. Functor.map_comp and associativity identify the result with the two specified support transitions and the original sfSupportPresentationLevel components. This proves the displayed equality on arbitrary unbounded K, including zero, the empty or identity open and n=0.

theorem sfSupportTransition_presentation
    (c : Compactification f) (o : IntegralOpenReduction.Operations l E c.i)
    (d : CompactSupportProperImageTower.DirectData l E c.g)
    (e : CompactSupportProperImageTower.OpenData l E c.i o)
    (ι : ∀ n : ℕ, IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtension l E c.i o n ≅
      sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero c.i (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)))
    (hι : SfFiniteOpenPresentationCompatible l E c.i o e ι)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) (n : ℕ) :
    CompactSupportProperImageTower.supportTransition l E c.i c.g o (d := d) e K n ≫
        (sfSupportPresentationLevel l E c o d ι K n).hom =
      (sfSupportPresentationLevel l E c o d ι K (n + 1)).hom ≫
        sfCompactSupportTransition l E c K n
